facts.fact: Amrita 想向 Sylvie 解释「因为魔——」，话卡在喉咙里说不出来（魔法仍封口）。
facts.anchor: Her voice choked in her throat. She cleared it and tried again.

facts.fact: 她意识到有种东西侵入她的生活与安全感并控制了她。
facts.anchor: Something had infiltrated her life, her home and safe space, and taken control of her.

facts.fact: Mia 说知道自己有魔法更像是「记起来」而不是从无到有地得知。
facts.anchor: it was a lot more like remembering than finding out from nothing

facts.fact: Mist 通过 Aiden 传话说两人是命定的，唯一能分开他们的是自己的选择。
facts.anchor: The only thing that will ever part you is your personal choice.

facts.fact: Aiden 说若要在魔法与 Mia 之间选择，他永远选她。
facts.anchor: If ever I had to choose, it would be you. Every time.

facts.fact: Mia 提议等朋友和 Sylvie 都好起来，明年再用手绑礼 handfasting 结婚。
Mist 说帮忙的人要包括 Amrita 和 Elara。
facts.anchor: We will need Amrita’s help too. And Elara’s.

facts.fact: Elara 觉察到 inn 有灵，说自己早有怀疑并答应参与计划。
facts.anchor: So you are an enchanted inn after all

facts.fact: 章末 Elara 感到 inn 因参与撮合两人而愉快。
魔法把抽屉倒空，花瓣落成一个心形围住一枚金色耳环。
facts.anchor: it was around a single golden earring

facts.fact: Jamie 说愿付出一切换回她，包括他的天赋。
